packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors.

PublicApiGenerator is referenced only by the Abstractions and Http test projects, where it drives approved-API snapshot tests. A behavioural change in it breaks those snapshots, which turns the required check red, so it cannot land silently.
AngleSharp parses HTML in Sanare's scraping path. It is a leaf dependency whose output the parsing tests assert directly, so a behavioural change surfaces as a failing test rather than silent drift.

Microsoft.Playwright is a runtime dependency of Sanare.Browser, and the Category=Browser tests that would exercise it are excluded from CI because no Chromium is installed on the runner, so CI only proves it still compiles. Automerged on all update types at owner's judgement that Playwright is well behaved and a browser-automation failure is obvious in use and cheap to revert; restore automerge:false if that stops holding.
